topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: Oh, hi there! I um, just got your note, didn't I? About the, the garden, yes. That's a um, that's a really interesting idea. I, I do love the thought of, of fresh veggies and, and flowers, don't get me wrong. It's just, well, the yard, it's pretty, pretty small, you see. And I, I've been meaning to, to really tidy it up, get it in order. Maybe, maybe we could talk about it a bit more? Figure out, you know, the best spot for, for your plans. How does that sound? I, I really do want to hear more about what you have in mind.
